authority: none; local measurements, not Docker, Harbor or official grades

protocol.exposure: The developer saw public instructions/task metadata; one Git API error exposed part of a commit title. No receiver gold edit or verifier in the staged producer. The route/acquisition controls are not solver transfer trials.
protocol.paired: Clean base only and fresh private room per revision; same host-side 15-source cold allowlist, new digest-identified empty artifact per revision. Reviewed worker argv relocated to /input/producer. Base-only venv vs expanded unit-deps venv are separate comparisons, not a single treatment. CPU 120s/wall 240s/2GiB address space; timings are measurements, not guarantees.
protocol.acquisition: Same public full instruction, BM25, <=4 test files and 15s per file per arm; selective reads up to 6 bodies vs all eligible <=200KB. A Python call-stage profile counts tests reaching any goal-named function in project code; names are noisy proxies. Ranking time excludes enumeration. Tests are native, not task verifiers.
protocol.refusal: Native reach and unrelated broken tests are not behavioral task evidence. A zero-byte source capture is not a replay reward.

drivers.notes: Early profiler runs preceded expanded diagnostics; reproduce final algorithm/outcomes, not timestamps or historical error formatting.
